set.body: Integrate pinned fixture freshness checks, portable scenario suites, benchmark receipts, coverage ledger, and reader-facing report into one focused gate. Acceptance: reference regeneration is separately runnable, ordinary JVM/JS tests consume checked fixtures without external runtimes, all scenario dispositions are accounted for, and the report distinguishes local proof from hosted regeneration.
set.title: C8: publish the MVPA external-conformance release court
